tei:div.tei:p: And it shall happen if you listen carefully to My commandments which I command you today, to love the Lord your God and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul, that I will grant the rain of your land in its season, the former rain and the latter rain, so that you will gather in your corn, your wine and your oil. I will give grass to your field for your cattle, and you shall eat and be satisfied. Take care that your heart be not deceived and that you do not turn aside and serve strange gods and bow down before them. For then the wrath of the Lord will burn against you and He will close the heavens so that no rain shall fall and the earth shall not yield its produce, and you shall soon perish from the good land that the Lord is giving you. Lay these words of mine upon your heart and upon your soul, bind them as a sign upon your arm and let them be frontlets between your eyes. Teach them to your children by talking about them when you sit in your house and walk on the way and when you lie down and when you rise up. You shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gates, so that your days and the days of your children may increase upon the soil which the Lord has sworn to your fathers to give to them, as the days of the heavens above the earth.
